notes.title: March 27 balance adjustments, improvements
notes.content:
bug fixes:

Fixed automatic font size and line wrapping display issues for Chinese characters under 720P resolution.
Fixed the issue where skill tactics descriptions wouldn't update after upgrading.
Fixed the issue where the settlement skill tactics list details panel only reads level 1 parameters.
Fixed the issue where the 1931 weapon affix would also block friendly projectiles.
Adjustments and additions:

Added gunner weapon settings display to the vehicle crew interface.
Added current level and current level difficulty display to the settlement interface.
Adjusted the color of firearm type indicators.
Added small coin drops for Valve assaulters, Valve snipers, and Valve attackers.
Added coin drops for the commander.
Increased the firepower of the [Lee-Enfield] weapon.
Slightly improved the performance of the skill tactic [Lightweight Racing Car].
Reduced the frequency of the commander's appearance in the [Train Depot] level.
Adjusted the projectile performance of Valve laborers (Da Zhuang).

notes.title: March 21 update announcement
notes.content:
Update content
1.English translation update, more in line with reading habits

Function update
1. Cancelled the primary and secondary weapon setting, and changed to upgrade the primary weapon through monster drops. Currently you can upgrade 2 times. The upgrade effect of each main weapon is different.
1.1 Sten upgrade effect: single shot becomes sparse three shots, single shot becomes dense three shots
1.2 1931 machine gun: When changing ammunition, it can trigger Faraday shield ball
1.3 M1911: Kill 15 enemies, you can summon a floating turret, the maximum simultaneous existence of three floating turrets
1.4 Winchester Shotgun: Every time a certain number of triggers are pulled, a "bat glide round" will be released
1.5 Lee Enfield: After upgrade, the bullet has a prismatic effect and will be refracted.
1.6 2" Grenade Launcher: For every 15 rounds of grenades fired, a "Vortex Fish" is summoned.
1.7 Bren Light Machine Gun: Hedgehog rocket, fires several rockets when changing magazines.
1.8 Bazooka: For every 10 rounds fired, a marker will be placed on the ground to guide the air force to bombing.
2. Fixed some other problems

notes.title: 2023年 1月30 更新说明
notes.content:
本次版本为平衡性调整中间版本
*** 为方便指挥官测试体验技能和后期怪物，游戏难度目前大幅下降。不过这个不是最终版本，过渡性版本。请留意。




功能调整与新增
    
    a.增加画面设置和音量设置
    b.优化怪物部署机制
    c.特效优化
    d.载具操作规则调整（单踏板模式，改为智能刹车加油）
    e.增加鼠标滚轮切枪，现在未装备的武器不会自动装填了。
    f.鼠标瞄准目标后会改变颜色并高亮显示
    g.获得第二武器时，系统有提示了。
    h.整体游戏画面渲染效率提高
    i.提高了大壮等人的生命值
    






bug修复
    1.修复捆绑弹夹无效的bug
    2.修复技战术轻装飙车效果错误的bug
    3.修复角色详情子弹数量不显示bug
    4.修复AI瞄准动画失效的bug
    5.修复战争中学习无效的bug，并调整数值
    6.部分技能得到了BUFF(略)
    7.修复了步枪阀门兵使用98K会三连发的BUG
    8. 火力重视 BUG修正

notes.title: Alpha Update V5
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay  adjustment[/b]
a. Increase the active reload function. shortcut key R
b. The skill icon reduces the compression level
c. Fix the bug that the second weapon does not enjoy the previous skill bonus
d. Fix the bug that the number of rounds to unlock the second weapon is wrong
e. Fix the bug that the diamond time parameter is calculated incorrectly
f. The increase value of the front oil tank and the side mounted oil tank is increased by 1.
g. Add tactics [grenadier supply]
  UI optimization
1. When the technical and tactical level is 0, the level number is gray
2. The rate of fire has been increased by level 2. Icon replacement
3. Add the second weapon switching prompt
4. The blood bar will now be displayed in two rows
5. Repair the bug that the equipment grid level is not updated in time when the technical tactics are upgraded after the equipment is equipped


balance adjustment
1. The 3-minute wave of tanks (offensive) has been slightly adjusted and weakened
2. The power of Mills grenade is increased by 10%, and the explosion range is increased by 10%
3. The laser tank's laser duration is too long. Bug fixes
4. Enemy small tanks will no longer outflank
